Here, we build and store the models required to obtain vital rate parameters to feed to the IPM.

## Setup

As usual, we fist load the package and get the data.

```{r}
library(whereipm)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(ggplot2)

# loading the data
data <- ipmdata %>% filter(sex == "F",
                           habitat == "P")

# I am here also defining 3 colours I will later use for plotting
col.early <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[1]
col.mid <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[2]
col.late <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[3]
```

To study how the evolution of dispersal and life-history affects the spatial ecology of the population we are splitting the 5 years of observation in 3 phases:

1. Early phase, between month 4 and month 15;
2. Mid phase, between month 26 and 37;
3. Late pahse, between month 48 and 59.

I will also subset the dataset to include only pools, and only females.

```{r}
# subsetting for sex, habitat and time. 
# Here I am considering only females since for males the number of offspring sired
# is complicated by sperm storage in females.
data <- data %>%
  mutate(phase = NA,
         phase = ifelse(time >= 4 & time <= 15, "early", NA),
         phase = ifelse(time >= 26 & time <= 37, "mid", phase),
         phase = ifelse(time >= 48 & time <= 59, "late", phase),
         phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))

table(data$phase)

data.early <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "early")
data.mid <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "mid")
data.late <- data %>%
  filter(phase == "late")
```

## Models

I will run 6 model trios, for different life-history and dispersal traits:

1. Survival;
2. Recruitment;
3. Adult dispersal probability;
4. Adult dispersal distance;
5. Natal dispersal probability;
6. Natal dispersal distance.

### Survival

```{r, results = "asis"}
# For survival, Local density is the only covariate.
# Random effects include individual identity, reach and sampling.

e.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.early,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

m.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ 1 +
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach)  + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.mid,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# s_loc_density not significant, removed from fixed factors

l.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ 1 +
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.late,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# s_loc_density not significant, removed from fixed factors

stargazer::stargazer(e.survival, m.survival, l.survival,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Models for survival",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = "Local density",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Survival probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")

# plotting survival across densities in the three phases
dens <- data.frame(loc_density = seq(0, 50, length.out = 100),
                   s_loc_density = seq(0, 50, length.out = 100)/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale)
# using custom made function predictGLMM to calculate survival in each phase, across density values
survival_plot <- dens %>%
  add_column(early = plogis(predict(e.survival, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             mid = plogis(predict(m.survival, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             late = plogis(predict(l.survival, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0))) %>%
  gather(key = "phase", value = "p_surv", -c(loc_density, s_loc_density)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))
            
s <- ggplot(data = survival_plot, aes(x = loc_density, colour = phase)) +
  geom_jitter(data = data %>% filter(!is.na(phase)),
              aes(y = jitter(survival), colour = phase),
              alpha = 0.1, shape = 1, height = 0.001) +
  geom_line(aes(y = p_surv), size = 0.8) + ylim(0,1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  ylab("survival (p)") + xlab("local density (n/m)") +
  ggtitle("Survival probability") +
  theme_bw()
s
```

### Recruitment

```{r, results = "asis"}
# For recruitment, the random effect structure is simplified, excluding a random slope for sampling.
e.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) +  (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data = data.early,
                              na.action = na.omit)

m.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.mid,
                              na.action = na.omit)

l.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID)+ (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID)+ (1|reach) +  (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.late,
                              na.action = na.omit)

sjPlot::tab_model(e.recruit, m.recruit, l.recruit,
                  show.icc = F, show.aic = F, show.se = T, show.est = T,
                  pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Local density"),
                  dv.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                  show.ci = F)


# local density only positively affects early phase Poisson. Intercept is set to 1 for all other models
e.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID) +  (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data = data.early,
                              na.action = na.omit)

m.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.mid,
                              na.action = na.omit)

l.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID)+ (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID)+ (1|reach) +  (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.late,
                              na.action = na.omit)

# plotting reproduction probability and number of offspring for the three phases, at various density values
# Reproduction probability 
# (remember this is probability to NOT reproduce, since it's a zero inflation model)
reproduction_plot <- dens %>%
  add_column(early = 1- predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.recruit)$coefficients$zi, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit"),
             mid = 1- predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.recruit)$coefficients$zi, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit"),
             late = 1- predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.recruit)$coefficients$zi, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")) %>%
  gather(key = "phase", value = "p_repr", -c(loc_density, s_loc_density)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))

offspring_plot <- dens %>%
  add_column(early = predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.recruit)$coefficients$cond, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "truncated-pois"),
             mid = predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.recruit)$coefficients$cond, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "truncated-pois"),
             late = predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.recruit)$coefficients$cond, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "truncated-pois")) %>%
  gather(key = "phase", value = "n_off", -c(loc_density, s_loc_density)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))
```

```{r , fig.height=4, fig.width=9}
# plotting
r <- ggplot(data = reproduction_plot, aes(x = loc_density, colour = phase)) +
  geom_jitter(data = data %>% filter (!is.na(phase)), 
              aes(y = jitter(as.numeric(recruited != 0)), colour = phase), 
              alpha = 0.1, shape = 1, height = 0.001) +
  geom_line(aes(y = p_repr), size = 0.8) + ylim(0,1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  ylab("reproduction (p)") + xlab("local density (individuals/m)") +
  ggtitle("Reproduction probability") +
  theme_bw()

o <- ggplot(data = offspring_plot, aes(x = loc_density, colour = phase)) +
  geom_jitter(data = data%>%filter(recruited>0, !is.na(phase)), 
              aes(y = jitter(recruited), colour = phase),
              alpha = 0.1, shape = 1, height = 0.001) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n_off, col = phase), size = 0.8) + ylim(1,7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  ylab("offspring (n)") + xlab("local density (n/m)") +
  ggtitle("Offspring number") +
  theme_bw()

r
o
```

Saving plot of survival and reproduction

```{r}
s <- s + xlab("") + theme(legend.position = "none")
r <- r + theme(legend.position = "none")
o <- o + xlab("")

jpeg(file.path(here::here(), "results", "FigureSM1.jpeg"), width = 9, height = 4, unit = "in", res = 400)
gridExtra::grid.arrange(s, r, o, ncol = 3, widths = c(0.8,0.8,1))
dev.off()
```

### Adult dispersal

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.early,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

# density does not significantly affect dispersal in the mid phase, so the intercept is set to 1
m.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ 1 +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.mid,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

l.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.late,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

stargazer::stargazer(e.dispersal.p, m.dispersal.p, l.dispersal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Adult dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = "Local density",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

### Adult dispersal distance

```{r, results = "asis", fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
e.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ 1 +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.early)

m.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ 1 +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.mid)

l.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ 1 +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.late)

stargazer::stargazer(e.dispersal.dist, m.dispersal.dist, l.dispersal.dist,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Models for adult dispersal distance",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal distance",
                     dep.var.labels = "")


# plotting dispersal probability and distance
# Probability
ad_prob_plot <- dens %>%
  add_column(early = plogis(predict(e.dispersal.p, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             mid = plogis(predict(m.dispersal.p, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             late = plogis(predict(l.dispersal.p, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0))) %>%
  gather(key = "phase", value = "p_add", -c(loc_density, s_loc_density)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))

# Distance
# dd.e <- predictGLMM(x = dens$loc_density, 
#                   Coefs = summary(e.dispersal.dist)$coefficients, 
#                   scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
#                   link = "log")
ad_dist_plot <- dens %>%
  add_column(early = exp(predict(e.dispersal.dist, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             mid = exp(predict(m.dispersal.dist, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             late = exp(predict(l.dispersal.dist, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0))) %>%
  gather(key = "phase", value = "d_add", -c(loc_density, s_loc_density)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))



# plots
ap <- ggplot(data = ad_prob_plot, aes(x = loc_density, colour = phase)) +
  geom_jitter(data = data %>% filter(!is.na(phase)),
              aes(y = jitter(p_moving), colour = phase), alpha = 0.1, shape = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = p_add), size = 0.8) + ylim(0,1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  ylab("adult dispersal (p)") + xlab("local density (n/m)") +
  ggtitle("Adult dispersal probability") +
  theme_bw()

ad <- ggplot(data = ad_dist_plot, aes(x = loc_density, colour = phase)) +
  geom_point(data = data %>% filter(!is.na(phase)),
             aes(y = dist_moved, colour = phase), alpha = 0.1, shape = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = d_add, col = phase), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  ylab("adult dispersal distance (m)") + xlab("local density (n/m)") +
  ggtitle("Adult dispersal distance") +
  theme_bw()

ap <- ap + theme(legend.position = "none") + xlab("")
ad <- ad + xlab("")
gridExtra::grid.arrange(ap, ad, ncol = 2, bottom = "local density (individuals/m)", padding = unit(1, "line"), widths = c(0.9, 1))

jpeg(file.path(here::here(), "results", "FigureSM2.jpeg"), width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", res = 400)
gridExtra::grid.arrange(ap, ad, ncol = 2, bottom = "local density (individuals/m)", padding = unit(1, "line"), widths = c(0.9, 1))
dev.off()
```

### Natal dispersal probability

```{r, results = "asis"}
# Since the DDD paper show importance of landscape density on natal dispersal, here I include it in the analyses
e.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = subset(data.early, mummoved == 0),
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

m.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = subset(data.mid, mummoved == 0),
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

l.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = subset(data.late, mummoved == 0), 
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))


stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.p, m.natal.p, l.natal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = c("Local density", "Landscape density",
                                          "Local x Landscape desity"),
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

Due to lack of convergence and significance, all models are adapted to remove non-significant factors.

```{r, results = "asis"}
# Since the DDD paper show importance of landscape density on natal dispersal, here I include it in the analyses
e.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ 1 +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = subset(data.early, mummoved == 0),
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

m.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = subset(data.mid, mummoved == 0),
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

l.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid+s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) ,
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = subset(data.late, mummoved == 0), 
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))


stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.p, m.natal.p, l.natal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = c("Local density", "Landscape density",
                                          "Local x Landscape desity"),
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

### Natal dispersal distance

```{r, results = "asis", fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
e.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ 1 + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (1|sampling.birth),
                           data = subset(data.early, mummoved == 0))

m.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ 1 + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (1|sampling.birth),
                           data = subset(data.mid, mummoved == 0))

l.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ 1  + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (1|sampling.birth),
                           data = subset(data.late, mummoved == 0))

stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.dist, m.natal.dist, l.natal.dist,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal distance",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal distance",
                     dep.var.labels = "")


# plotting dispersal probability and distance
# probability depends on local and landscape density together
land_dens <- data.frame(land_density = seq(0.5, 7.5, length.out = 8))
dens_x <- expand.grid(loc_density = dens$loc_density,
                      land_density = land_dens$land_density) %>%
  mutate(s_loc_density.mid = loc_density/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
         s_land_density.mid = land_density/scalingAttr$land_density$scale)

# Probability
np.e <- cbind(dens_x, preds = plogis(predict(e.natal.p, newdata = dens_x, re.form = ~ 0)),
              phase = "early")
np.m <- cbind(dens_x, preds = plogis(predict(m.natal.p, newdata = dens_x, re.form = ~ 0)),
              phase = "mid")
np.l <- cbind(dens_x, preds = plogis(predict(l.natal.p, newdata = dens_x, re.form = ~ 0)),
              phase = "late")
nps <- rbind(np.e, np.m, np.l)

# this predictions reflect all possible observations of local and landscape density.
# not all though are observed in all phases. In the graphs, I want to make a distinction
# between what's observed (based on the range of local and landscape density in
# each phase) and what's extrapolated (outside of those ranges)
eloc.range <- range(data.early$loc_density, na.rm = T)
eland.range <- range(data.early$land_density, na.rm = T)
mloc.range <- range(data.mid$loc_density, na.rm = T)
mland.range <- range(data.mid$land_density, na.rm = T)
lloc.range <- range(data.late$loc_density, na.rm = T)
lland.range <- range(data.late$land_density, na.rm = T)
# creating small dataset to keep track of minimum and maximum observed densities in each phase
max_mins <- data.frame(phase = c("early", "mid", "late"),
                       min_loc = floor(c(eloc.range[1], mloc.range[1], lloc.range[1])),
                       max_loc = ceiling(c(eloc.range[2], mloc.range[2], lloc.range[2])),
                       min_land = floor(c(eland.range[1], mland.range[1], lland.range[1])),
                       max_land = ceiling(c(eland.range[2], mland.range[2], lland.range[2])))
# merging into main prediction dataset
nps <- left_join(nps, max_mins) %>%
  add_column(observed = FALSE)

npss <- nps %>%
  mutate(observed = (land_density >= min_land & land_density <= max_land &
                       loc_density >= min_loc & loc_density <= max_loc)) %>%
  filter(observed) %>%
  bind_rows(nps, .) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))

# Distance
juv_dist_plot <- dens %>%
  add_column(early = exp(predict(e.natal.dist, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             mid = exp(predict(m.natal.dist, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0)),
             late = exp(predict(l.natal.dist, newdata = dens, re.form = ~ 0))) %>%
  gather(key = "phase", value = "d_juvd", -c(loc_density, s_loc_density)) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")))


# plots
np <- ggplot(npss %>% filter(!observed), aes(x = loc_density, y = preds, group = phase)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = phase), linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(data = npss %>% filter(observed), aes(colour = phase), linetype = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 20, 40)) +
  facet_grid(phase ~ land_density) +
  ylab("dispersal probability") + xlab("local density (individuals/m)") +
  theme_bw()
np
jpeg(file.path(here::here(), "results", "FigureSM3.jpeg"), width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", res = 400)
np + theme(legend.position = "none")
dev.off()

# Distance
ggplot(data = juv_dist_plot, aes(x = loc_density)) +
  geom_point(data = data, aes(y = dist_natal), alpha = 0.1, shape = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = d_juvd, col = phase), size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late)) +
  ylab("natal dispersal distance (m)") + xlab("local density (n/m)") +
  ggtitle("Natal dispersal distance")
```

## Storing models

I will store models as a tibble.

```{r}
# storing data and models
vitalRateModels <- tibble(phase = c("early", "mid", "late"),
                          data = list(data.early, data.mid, data.late),
                          survival = list(e.survival, m.survival, l.survival),
                          recruit = list(e.recruit, m.recruit, l.recruit),
                          adDispersal = list(e.dispersal.p, m.dispersal.p, l.dispersal.p),
                          adDistance = list(e.dispersal.dist, 
                                            m.dispersal.dist, l.dispersal.dist),
                          natDispersal = list(e.natal.p, m.natal.p, l.natal.p),
                          natDistance = list(e.natal.dist, m.natal.dist, l.natal.dist))

# saving models
saveRDS(vitalRateModels, file = file.path(here::here(), "results", "vitalRateModels.rds"))
```
